VISA 101.title: BFA Studio Practice
VISA 101.description: Introduction to a broad range of contemporary studio practice. Intended for first year Bachelor of Fine Arts VISA students.

VISA 110.title: Foundation Studio: Digital Media
VISA 110.description: Foundation instruction in techniques and approaches to digital practice. The nature of digital technologies and their role in contemporary culture will be examined. (This course is open to all UBC students, regardless of prior experience.)

VISA 180.title: Foundation Studio: Approaches to Media
VISA 180.description: Drawing, painting, and related media in an introduction to studio practice. (This course is open to all UBC students, regardless of prior experience.)

VISA 183.title: Foundation Studio: Ideas as Practice I
VISA 183.description: Contemporary art practices, emphasizing the relationship between meanings and materials, art historical contexts and concepts, and non-traditional materials. (This course is open to all UBC students, regardless of prior experience.)

VISA 210.title: Digital Arts
VISA 210.description: Examination of current art practices and issues related to digital technologies and contemporary culture, with an emphasis on the theoretical conceptualization of digital artistic media.

children.raw: A score of 72% or higher in

VISA 210.prerequisiteText: A score of 72% or higher in two of VISA 110, VISA 180, VISA 183; or BMS student and VISA 110

VISA 220.title: Drawing
VISA 220.description: Development of skills in drawing including life drawing. Introduction to the development of personal style and concepts.

prerequisite.raw: A score of 72% or higher in

VISA 220.prerequisiteText: A score of 72% or higher in two of VISA 110, VISA 180, VISA 183

VISA 230.title: Painting
VISA 230.description: Development of a variety of techniques and approaches to painting. Emphasis on developing a strong paint vocabulary as well as acquiring knowledge of historical and contemporary issues in painting.

prerequisite.raw: A score of 72% or higher in

VISA 230.prerequisiteText: A score of 72% or higher in two of VISA 110, VISA 180, VISA 183

VISA 240.title: Photography
VISA 240.description: Introduction to photography techniques and image-making. Emphasis on camera techniques and film and darkroom production. Only one of VISA 240 or VISA 241 may be used toward requirements for Major, Minor, or Honours programs in Visual Arts.

prerequisite.raw: A score of 72% or higher in

VISA 240.prerequisiteText: A score of 72% or higher in two of VISA 110, VISA 180, VISA 183

VISA 241.title: Digital Photography
VISA 241.description: Introduction to digital photography image creation in relation to contemporary art. Emphasis on digital camera use, file management, and digital print production. Only one of VISA 240 or VISA 241 may be used toward requirements for Major, Minor, or Honours programs in Visual Arts.

children.raw: A score of 72% or higher in

VISA 241.prerequisiteText: A score of 72% or higher in two of VISA 110, VISA 180, VISA 183; or BMS student and VISA 110

VISA 250.title: Print Media
VISA 250.description: Visual print culture, and contemporary and historical technical print practices. Emphasis on hand-drawn intaglio, relief, screen and/or stencil printing, and graphic digital applications.

prerequisite.raw: A score of 72% or higher in

VISA 250.prerequisiteText: A score of 72% or higher in two of VISA 110, VISA 180, VISA 183

VISA 260.title: Sculpture
VISA 260.description: Contemporary sculpture practice and theory. Various sculpture materials and technologies including machinery use.

prerequisite.raw: A score of 72% or higher in

VISA 260.prerequisiteText: A score of 72% or higher in two of VISA 110, VISA 180, VISA 183

VISA 270.title: Special Studies
VISA 270.description: Introduction to various aspects of contemporary studio practice. Not offered every year.

prerequisite.raw: A score of 72% or higher in

VISA 270.prerequisiteText: A score of 72% or higher in two of VISA 110, VISA 180, VISA 183

VISA 280.title: Contemporary Art: Ideas as Practice II
VISA 280.description: Development and history of contemporary art practice, with a focus on how artists realize and exchange ideas. Intended for second year BFA VISA students.

prerequisite.raw: A score of 72% or higher in

VISA 280.prerequisiteText: A score of 72% or higher in VISA 183

VISA 310.title: Intermediate Digital Arts I
VISA 310.description: Exploring issues and topics in interactive digital media and culture through the creation of critical contemporary art. Includes technical instruction with a focus on the development of individual and group projects.

VISA 311.title: Intermediate Digital Arts II
VISA 311.description: Investigation of issues and topics in digital media and visual culture through the production of contemporary video art. Technical instruction in video manipulation software. Individual and/or group projects.

VISA 312.title: Expanded Visual Media
VISA 312.description: Pre- and/or post-production strategies, techniques, and processes for time-based media effects.
VISA 312.prerequisiteText: One of VISA 241, VISA 210, FIPR 133, FIPR 233. Or B.M.S. students with 3rd year standing

VISA 320.title: Intermediate Drawing I
VISA 320.description: Investigation of drawing as a discipline in the context of contemporary art. Emphasis on expanding definitions of the drawing practice while focusing on technical and conceptual development.

VISA 321.title: Intermediate Drawing II
VISA 321.description: Investigation of drawing as a discipline in the context of contemporary art and theory. Emphasis on self-directed projects in consultation with the instructor.

VISA 330.title: Intermediate Painting I
VISA 330.description: Development of techniques and personal style in relation to ideas. History and contemporary issues in painting will be introduced to assist students in conceptualizing their painting practice.

VISA 331.title: Intermediate Painting II
VISA 331.description: Further investigation of painting in the context of contemporary art. Emphasis on self directed projects in consultation with the instructor.

VISA 340.title: Intermediate Photography I
VISA 340.description: An investigation of approaches to photography and its meaning in the context of contemporary art. The term theme will be determined by the instructor. B & W, colour and digital production.

VISA 341.title: Intermediate Photography II
VISA 341.description: An investigation of contemporary photography production and approaches to the constructed image with emphasis on medium and large format camera use and studio lighting techniques.

VISA 350.title: Intermediate Print Media I: Interdisciplinary Approaches to Image Production
VISA 350.description: Intaglio and relief print applications (i.e., etching, wood and/or lino cut, and collagraph) in combination with digital and photographic technologies, and drawing; discussion of contemporary and historical visual print culture.
VISA 350.prerequisiteText: Either (a) VISA 250 or (b) one of VISA 290, VISA 283, VISA 284, FINA 290, FINA 283, FINA 284

VISA 351.title: Intermediate Print Media II: Interdisciplinary Approaches to Image Production
VISA 351.description: Screen printing and other print applications in combination with digital and photographic technologies, and drawing, explored within the context of contemporary art.
VISA 351.prerequisiteText: Either(a) VISA 250 or (b) one of VISA 283, VISA 284, VISA 290, FINA 283, FINA 284, FINA 290

VISA 352.title: Intermediate Print Media III: Interdisciplinary Approaches to Image Production
VISA 352.description: Lithographic printing; suitable for students interested in drawing and print media interface in context of contemporary art; related digital and photographic technologies employed.
VISA 352.prerequisiteText: Either (a) one of VISA 220, VISA 250 or (b) one of VISA 281, FINA 281, VISA 283, VISA 284, VISA 290, FINA 283, FINA 284, FINA 290

VISA 360.title: Intermediate Sculpture I
VISA 360.description: Investigation of contemporary practices in sculpture and the use of scale. Emphasis on public sculpture.
VISA 360.prerequisiteText: One of VISA 260, VISA 285, VISA 286, FINA 285, FINA 286

VISA 361.title: Intermediate Sculpture II
VISA 361.description: Development of personal concerns in three-dimensional work. Emphasis on the integration of diverse materials and techniques.
VISA 361.prerequisiteText: One of VISA 260, VISA 285, VISA 286, FINA 285, FINA 286

VISA 370.title: Special Studies I
VISA 370.description: Intermediate tutorial. Not offered every year.

prerequisite.raw: 6 credits of 200-level VISA

VISA 371.title: Special Studies II
VISA 371.description: Intermediate tutorial. Not offered every year.

prerequisite.raw: 6 credits of 200 level VISA

VISA 375.title: Artists in Society
VISA 375.description: Exploring artistic practice through community-engaged partnerships and critical study.

prerequisite.raw: Restricted to students with at least third-year standing, majoring in Visual Art or Art History

VISA 375.prerequisiteText: Restricted to students with at least third-year standing, majoring in Visual Art or Art History

VISA 376.title: Artist Books as Form and Idea
VISA 376.description: Approaches to book creation from the perspective of contemporary art and exploration of the artist book as an expansion of both art and books.

prerequisite.raw: 3 credits of any 200-level VISA course

VISA 380.title: Studio Theory
VISA 380.description: A seminar in problems in contemporary art practice and related theory. Preference given to Visual Art students.

VISA 381.title: Studio Seminar
VISA 381.description: A seminar in problems in contemporary art practice and related theory. Preference given to Visual Art students.

prerequisite.raw: VISA_V 380

VISA 390.title: Performance Art
VISA 390.description: Seminar-based studio focusing on performance and actions in the field of contemporary art.

prerequisite.raw: 6 credits of 200-level VISA with an average of at least 72%

VISA 390.prerequisiteText: 6 credits of 200-level VISA with an average of at least 72%

VISA 401.title: Advanced Open Studio
VISA 401.description: Research-based studio with thematic or disciplinary focus. Intended for senior Visual Art undergraduate students.
VISA 401.prerequisiteText: Three of VISA_V 310, VISA_V 311, VISA_V 320, VISA_V 321, VISA_V 330, VISA_V 331, VISA_V 340, VISA_V 341, VISA_V 350, VISA_V 351, VISA_V 352, VISA_V 360, VISA_V 361, VISA_V 370, VISA_V 375, VISA_V 390

VISA 410.title: Advanced Digital Arts I
VISA 410.description: Development of contemporary art works utilizing digital technologies including 3-dimensional applications, spatial, interactive and time-based installations. Focus on student-generated projects, either individual or group.

children.raw: Plus an additional 3 credits of 300-level VISA_V

VISA 410.prerequisiteText: One of VISA_V 310, VISA_V 311. Plus an additional 3 credits of 300-level VISA_V

VISA 411.title: Advanced Digital Arts II: Video
VISA 411.description: Contemporary practices in video media examined through individual projects and directed study.

children.raw: Plus an additional 3 credits of 300-level VISA_V

VISA 411.prerequisiteText: One of VISA_V 310, VISA_V 311. Plus an additional 3 credits of 300-level VISA_V

VISA 430.title: Advanced Drawing and Painting I
VISA 430.description: Interdisciplinary studio practice with emphasis on drawing, painting, and related media.
VISA 430.prerequisiteText: Two of VISA_V 320, VISA_V 321, VISA_V 330, VISA_V 331

VISA 431.title: Advanced Drawing and Painting II
VISA 431.description: Interdisciplinary studio practice with emphasis on drawing, painting, and related media.
VISA 431.prerequisiteText: Two of VISA_V 320, VISA_V 321, VISA_V 330, VISA_V 331

VISA 440.title: Advanced Photography I
VISA 440.description: Photography practice in the context of contemporary art. Interdisciplinary connections to other media will be encouraged.

VISA 441.title: Advanced Photography II
VISA 441.description: The production of self-directed projects investigating photography as art. Focus on integrative approaches including conventional, digital and multi-media.

VISA 450.title: Advanced Print Media and Sculpture I
VISA 450.description: Studies in contemporary trends in studio practice and theory. Emphasis on advanced two and three-dimensional work developed out of experimental approaches to sculpture, installation art and print-based media.

children.raw: Plus an additional 3 credits of 300-level VISA_V

VISA 450.prerequisiteText: One of VISA_V 350, VISA_V 351, VISA_V 360, VISA_V 361. Plus an additional 3 credits of 300-level VISA_V

VISA 451.title: Advanced Print Media and Sculpture II
VISA 451.description: Further studies in advanced two and three-dimensional work developed out of experimental approaches to sculpture, installation art and print-based media.

children.raw: Plus an additional 3 credits of 300-level VISA_V

VISA 451.prerequisiteText: One of VISA_V 350, VISA_V 351, VISA_V 360, VISA_V 361. Plus an additional 3 credits of 300-level VISA_V

VISA 469.title: Interdisciplinary Projects
VISA 469.description: Group projects and workshops with students majoring in other creative arts.

prerequisite.raw: Permission of instructor

VISA 470.title: Advanced Special Studies I
VISA 470.description: Advanced work in contemporary and historical aspects of studio practice. Not offered every year.

prerequisite.raw: 6 credits of 300-level VISA_V

VISA 471.title: Advanced Special Studies II
VISA 471.description: Advanced work in contemporary and historical aspects of studio practice. Not offered every year.

prerequisite.raw: 6 credits of 300-level VISA_V

VISA 475.title: Exhibition Theory and Practice
VISA 475.description: Exhibition course focusing on current curatorial practices and theories with an emphasis on contemporary visual art with the aim of preparing students to engage in the active organization of a large exhibition. Restricted to 4th year Majors in either VISA or ARTH, or permission of the instructor.

VISA 479.title: Performance Actions and Approaches
VISA 479.description: Advanced performance art practices and research methodologies.

VISA 480.title: Advanced Seminar I
VISA 480.description: Readings in art theory and criticism.

prerequisite.raw: VISA_V 380

VISA 481.title: Advanced Seminar II
VISA 481.description: Readings in art theory and criticism.

prerequisite.raw: VISA_V 480

VISA 490.title: Advanced Tutorial in Studio I
VISA 490.description: Advanced work in contemporary and historical aspects of studio practice. Permission of instructor required. Not offered every year.

prerequisite.raw: 6 credits of 300-level VISA_V and 3 credits of 400-level VISA_V

VISA 490.prerequisiteText: 6 credits of 300-level VISA_V and 3 credits of 400-level VISA_V

VISA 491.title: Advanced Tutorial in Studio II
VISA 491.description: Advanced work in contemporary and historical aspects of studio practice. Permission of instructor required.

prerequisite.raw: 6 credits of 300-level VISA_V and 3 credits of 400-level VISA_V

VISA 491.prerequisiteText: 6 credits of 300-level VISA_V and 3 credits of 400-level VISA_V

VISA 590.title: Directed Studies in Visual Art
VISA 590.description: Tutorial work in visual arts and theory arranged by permission with an individual faculty member. Not available to students enrolled in the M.F.A. program in Visual Arts.
